title: price the 35 parameter-directory write sites the E420 call index could not place, splitting the instrument's blind spot from the tree's silence

correction.note: E420's own three face rows are untouched by this study; only its corpus half moves, because the call index it offered them to was built from non-literal parameter helper names only

method_limits: the wide index is still name-based: a helper name shared by two files admits a foreign call site, so a hit is a place the directory could come from, not proof of which call produced the face on disk
the mention scan covers text extensions under 300 KB and prunes data/, results/, legacy/, Money02/ and .codely-cli/; a helper named only in a file it skipped reads as no_call_site_anywhere
fixture_shaped is a name heuristic (func or path contains fixture/_mk/_toy/_stub/_panel/_save), not a measurement of whether the code is a test
no writer was edited and no face on disk was read: this is a census of source text, so a site deleted in the tree since the last scan is invisible
